intro.title: Engineering energy independence
intro.body: [Placeholder] Solluz Synergy is a solar energy solutions company helping households, offices and industries move away from unreliable grid supply and costly generators. From the first load assessment to commissioning and after-sales support, our team delivers systems sized correctly for how you actually use power.

about.overview: [Placeholder company overview] Solluz Synergy provides end-to-end solar energy solutions – consultation, system design, supply, installation and maintenance – for residential, commercial and industrial clients. We combine quality components with careful engineering so every system performs reliably in Nigerian conditions.
about.mission: [Placeholder] To make clean, dependable and affordable power accessible to every home and business we serve.
about.vision: [Placeholder] To be Nigeria's most trusted partner for renewable energy and energy independence.
